author: Murphh
body:
Yesterday I was playing walls on Wild West on the green team.  Magnivi tried to team kill me multiple times using fire chargers and then spawning a blaze next to me.  Then he/she stopped trying to kill me and decided to grief my iron from furnaces instead. 

I didn't die, but he/she ruined my gameplay with the distractions.
